name: Amram Avraham Cons
summary: Amram Avraham Construction Company Ltd operated private construction projects in Israel. The company operates in The Entrepreneurial Real Estate in Israel and The Responsive Real Estate Sector in Israel segments. The Entrepreneurial Real Estate in Israel segment includes land identification, improvement processes and initiation, construction and sale of real projects in the real estate sector. The Responsive Real Estate Sector segment in Israel includes locating, initiating, establishing, renting, and managing real estate for investment, industrial, warehousing, logistics, Industry, storage, logistics, trade, offices or hotels. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Hadera, Israel.
